rotationPolicy.note: rotate every 12 months (6,307,200 heights at the 5 s reference block time); the rotation manifest is signed by 2-of-3 of the current set

lossProcedure: loss or compromise of one key: the remaining 2-of-3 quorum signs a manifest that revokes it and rotates in a new key; loss of two keys: the set cannot sign and a new ceremony plus network configuration change is required
custody: director custody on 3 separate devices; each private key encrypted with a separate passphrase
